title: Regime-Based World Modeling: A Layered Epistemic Architecture for Complex Systems
abstract: Introduces Regime-Based World Modeling (RBWM), a meta-epistemic framework that maps scientific claims onto a two-axis coordinate system: the Regime axis (R) for emergent complexity levels and the Epistemic Layer axis (L) for derivation distance from observation. It generalizes the Regime-Gating Principle, asserting that claims are valid only when expressed in driver-near variables for the operative regime, thereby preventing regime leakage and clarifying conflicts between models operating at different epistemic coordinates.
